about: The Markdown keys of a multi-line field, as cases both apps' tests read (the desktop's composer-keys.ts, Android's MarkdownEdit.kt). `input` marks the cursor with | or the selection with « and »; `expected` is the field after the edit in the same marks, or null when the key is left to the field (Enter then sends on the desktop and adds a line on a phone; Tab moves the focus). `action` is one of: enter, tab, shift-tab, bold, italic, code, link.

cases.name: Enter on plain text is the field's own
Enter continues a dash list
Enter continues an indented star list
Enter takes the next number
Enter keeps a numbered list's parenthesis and carries to two digits
Enter on a done task opens an empty task box
Enter on an empty item ends the list
Enter on an empty item of another kind ends the list too
Enter with the cursor inside the marker is not a new item
Enter with a selection is not a new item
Tab indents a list item
Shift+Tab outdents a list item
Tab indents every line of a selection
Shift+Tab outdents every line of a selection, by what each has
Shift+Tab with nothing to outdent is left alone
Tab on plain text with no selection is left alone
Shift+Tab on an indented plain line is left alone
Bold wraps the selection
Bold unwraps a selection that is wrapped around
Bold unwraps a selection that holds its own markers
Bold wraps two spans rather than breaking them
Italic wraps a name with underscores rather than unwrapping it
Italic with no selection puts the cursor between
Code wraps the selection
A link takes the selection as its text and the cursor in the address
A link with no selection puts the cursor in its text
